_era: Setting: Đại Việt (Vietnam), early 15th century, under Ming occupation. Vietnamese men wear long cross-collar tunics (áo giao lĩnh) in brown, indigo or dark blue, loose trousers, black cloth head wraps over hair tied in a topknot, bare feet or straw sandals; commoners may wear a palm-leaf conical hat. No Chinese queue hairstyles, no Qing clothing, no Japanese clothing. Landscape: rivers, rice paddies, bamboo, limestone karst hills.
g1: Night on a calm wide river among misty karst hills: a Vietnamese fisherman in a small wooden boat hauls up his net by the light of a burning torch; caught in the wet net is a long dark iron bar faintly glowing. Moonlight on the water.
g2: Close-up at night in the boat: the amazed fisherman holds the iron bar up to his torch, and two engraved Chinese characters 順天 glow softly on the old blade. Firelight on his face, river mist behind.
g3: Dusk in a forest: a huge ancient banyan tree with hanging aerial roots; high in its branches a jeweled sword hilt glows with golden light. Below, a dignified Vietnamese leader in his thirties with a short beard, dark blue cross-collar tunic and black head wrap, looks up in wonder, holding his horse's reins.
g4: The Vietnamese leader with a short beard in a dark blue tunic and black head wrap raises a complete straight double-edged sword toward the sky; the blade glows faintly. Behind him on a hill, a small band of Vietnamese rebels with spears and banners cheer. Dramatic sunrise clouds.
g5: A peaceful green lake in the middle of an old Vietnamese capital city in the 15th century, on a flat river plain with no mountains, tiled-roof wooden houses and willow trees along the shore: the king in a golden-yellow robe and black winged court hat stands in a royal dragon boat; a giant golden turtle rises from the water before him.
g6: The same flat lake in the old Vietnamese capital at dawn, no mountains anywhere, tiled-roof houses and willows on the far shore: the king in a golden-yellow robe and black winged court hat stands in his royal dragon boat with an arm outstretched; a glowing sword flies from his hand toward a giant golden turtle that is sinking back beneath the surface in a ring of ripples. Golden morning light and mist.
